wikipedia:en.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
wikipedia:en.extract: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is a 2026 first-person shooter game developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision. It is the twenty-third installment in the Call of Duty series and the fourth and final entry in the rebooted Modern Warfare sub-series, following Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III (2023). It was released on October 23, 2026, for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S. Prior to release, Modern Warfare 4 received positive reviews from critics, with praise for its campaign mode.

wikipedia:es.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
wikipedia:es.extract: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 es un juego de disparos en primera persona desarrollado por Infinity Ward y publicado por Activision. Es la vigésimo tercera entrega de la serie Call of Duty y la cuarta de la subsaga Modern Warfare, que ha sido reiniciada, después de Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III (2023). Fue lanzado el 23 de octubre de 2026 para Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Windows y Xbox Series X/S.​
